preserve_edge_cases.why: WAL with uncheckpointed data survives backup+migration; tamper detection via checksum rewrite; rollback restores business rows bit-identical; schema version 999 downgrade blocked instead of clobbered

split-fill rows must NEVER be treated as duplicates; below-1.0 confidence blocks deletion entirely; archive checksum verified before delete. Directly guards known 'hygiene duplicate detection' regression
guard codes never become audit_signals rows; purge respects per-table retention and NEVER touches audit_ledger (accounting truth); identical decision across request_ids collapses to exactly one row

broker-server-local epoch (+3h) mapped to real UTC, not treated as UTC; NaN/garbage timestamp -> None (never raised, never fabricated); deal net_result = profit - swap - commission - fee; fixed-offset tz converted to UTC with correct hour rollback

HTTP 429/DNS failures return typed errors not fabricated releases; rollback restores app snapshot but NEVER old user data (in-tree artifacts/data/logs survive); telegram credentials preserved across update; migration version-aware; interrupted downloads recover
already-v7 DB is a true no-op (pending empty); migration records backup path and leaves ledger PnL sum bit-exact (14.5) with FK check clean

UI masked-token round-trip submits empty string — must NOT wipe the secret store; token persists to secret store with YAML verified token-free; explicit clear disables while keeping enabled=false semantics
legacy YAML->secret-store migration failure keeps legacy working (no data-loss cliff); corrupt settings DB reports degraded state instead of crashing; secrets encrypted/absent on disk
real uvicorn SSE stream sanitized (no traceback/file://); sqlite error text and filesystem paths never leak; request-id echo + autogeneration contract
the still-forming M1 minute must ship is_complete=False (61 bars = 60 completed + forming) and its OHLC never joins the completed tail — the exact BUG-082 / web div-balance regression

exact-content dedup collapses; historical articles immutable (versioned, never overwritten); news can neither force a buy nor bypass risk gates; local evidence authoritative after API failure; news subsystem must import without MT5
Windows-specific polars scalar access must not raise OSError; future-dated news strictly invisible at T; identical-timestamp duplicate selection deterministic (last-of-group wins)
NaN/Inf must never reach a training dataset; unknown categorical values encode deterministically (never NaN/random); benchmark runner refuses synthetic news shape — guards dataset integrity
failed send must not poison dedup cache (retry still fires); identical non-digit-prefix messages must not conflate (signature collisions); HTML escaping + 4096 truncation with closing tags
aggregation must never average CRITICAL away; UNKNOWN ordering semantics; historical duplicates degrade to WARNING while new duplicates are CRITICAL; the health engine is provably read-only

55 repeats collapse to one incident via stable fingerprint; exported zip bundle strips secrets; quarantine keeps the record (never deletes); clock skew measured not assumed; same fingerprint after a fix flags a regression candidate

SSE serialization errors surface with correlation_id in the debug console (known SSE serialization regression); every canonical type (datetime/features/model) serializes; no secret keys leak into snapshot JSON
legacy scalp_v4 blocked from production candidates; head3 weight tampering detected; 3-class models rejected (contract is 4-class)
secrets scan distinguishes REAL tokens from placeholders (no false positives); identity mismatch (build-info version rewrite) fails verification
